name: Re Protocol reUSD
oneLiner: reUSD is Re Protocol's NAV-based yield token deploying USDC and USDe/sUSDe into delta-neutral ETH basis trades and short-duration U.S. T-bills (Cayman Islands).
collateral: USDC, USDe, and sUSDe deployed into delta-neutral ETH basis trades or short-duration U.S. Treasury bills via the Re Protocol Insurance Capital Layer
pegMechanism: NAV-based token price recalculated daily at UTC 00:00 via Chainlink price feed; yield accrues from delta-neutral ETH basis trade or T-bill returns plus 250 bps protocol spread; atomic redemptions when instant liquidity available, otherwise queue mode

oracleRisk.summary: reUSD is a NAV-based strategy token rather than a collateralized debt position, so it has no collateral health factor or oracle-triggered liquidation branch.

branchApplicability.rationale: Re Protocol documents reUSD as a token received for deposits whose backing is allocated to delta-neutral ETH basis trades or short-duration Treasury bills, with daily NAV updates and liquidity-dependent redemptions. It does not document user debt positions, collateral ratios, or oracle-triggered collateral liquidations, so CDP collateral branches are not applicable.

applicabilityBasis.summary: reUSD is a NAV-based yield-accruing token issued exclusively to non-U.S. persons under Regulation S (Securities Act of 1933). It accrues yield from delta-neutral ETH basis trades and T-bills, carries significant risk including total loss of principal, offers gated/queue redemptions, and is not marketed or used as a 1:1 fiat payment instrument. These features place it outside GENIUS payment-stablecoin scope.

genius.notes: reUSD is a yield-bearing, NAV-based insurance capital token restricted to non-U.S. persons under Regulation S. The issuer is Resilience Foundation (full legal name: Resilience Foundation Company), an Exempted Limited Guarantee Foundation Company incorporated in the Cayman Islands (IC-414560), not a BVI entity. A related entity Resilience (BVI) Ltd exists in BVI but is not the token issuer. Prior entry listed issuerDomicile as British Virgin Islands — corrected to Cayman Islands. No GENIUS payment-stablecoin applicability; not-applicable status is appropriate.

mintAuthority.summary: reUSD currently grants MINTER_ROLE to a collateral-deposit layer, an immutable redemption contract with no mint call, and a CCIP burn/mint pool. A two-day TimelockController holds token admin and UUPS upgrade roles; a 3-of-5 Safe is its sole proposer, executor, and canceller.

upgradeability.controlRef: reUSD token admin and UUPS upgrader timelock

controls.label: reUSD InsuranceCapitalLayer MINTER_ROLE holder
controls.capDescription: The verified InsuranceCapitalLayer mints reUSD shares only after supported collateral is transferred in and share conversion checks pass. Its own UUPS upgrader role is held by the same two-day timelock that controls reUSD.
controls.evidence: The complete RoleGranted/RoleRevoked history plus hasRole() at Ethereum block 25530324 confirms this proxy still holds reUSD MINTER_ROLE. Verified InsuranceCapitalLayer source calls shareToken.mint() only in collateral-backed deposit flows; its UPGRADER_ROLE is held by timelock 0x69dDEa....

controls.label: reUSD InstantRedemption MINTER_ROLE holder
controls.evidence: hasRole(MINTER_ROLE) was true at Ethereum block 25530324, but the verified immutable InstantRedemption bytecode exposes redemption and burn flows and contains no call to ShareToken.mint(). The role assignment therefore is not a live callable mint surface in this implementation.

controls.label: reUSD CCIP burn/mint pool
controls.capDescription: The verified BurnWithFromMintTokenPool can mint only through validated CCIP releaseOrMint messages and configured remote-chain rate limits; its owner is the reviewed reUSD Safe.
controls.evidence: The complete role-event history and hasRole() confirm this pool holds reUSD MINTER_ROLE at block 25530324. Verified pool source mints in _releaseOrMint() after CCIP validation. owner() returned Safe 0x8eec10616802Ef639CA55c98ac856553fAdEfBaD.

controls.label: reUSD token admin and UUPS upgrader timelock
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25530324, hasRole() confirmed this TimelockController is the sole current reUSD DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and UPGRADER_ROLE holder; getMinDelay() returned 172800 seconds. Verified ShareToken source gates minting by MINTER_ROLE and UUPS replacement by UPGRADER_ROLE.

controls.label: reUSD governance Safe
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25530324, Safe calls returned threshold 3 and five owners; Safe Transaction Service reported version 1.4.1, no modules, and zero guard. Timelock hasRole() returned true for this Safe as the sole PROPOSER_ROLE, EXECUTOR_ROLE, and CANCELLER_ROLE holder.

review.evidence: A complete Blockscout RoleGranted/RoleRevoked event replay through Ethereum block 25530324, followed by direct hasRole() checks, found three live MINTER_ROLE holders, one DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder, and one UPGRADER_ROLE holder. Verified implementations establish the callable behavior of each minter. The admin/upgrader is a 172800-second TimelockController governed by a 3-of-5 Safe with no modules or guard.
